newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks little changed in London.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks little changed in London.

text.p: Japanese stocks were little changed in London in thin featureless trading, dealers said.
They said there appeared to be a bit of selling interest, but few actual trades were executed.
"There are some worries that (the Nikkei 225) topped out and is headed back down below 20,000," said one dealer.
The Nikkei 50 index was down 0.49 point to 1,620.03 at 1400 GMT.
In Tokyo, the Nikkei 225 index fell 132.02 points to 20,048.90.
